structure.kind: npm workspaces monorepo (root package 'frisson', ESM, node >=22.18)
structure.language: TypeScript; API runs .ts natively with no compile step

workspaces.apps/api: Fastify 5, fastify-type-provider-zod, Drizzle + better-sqlite3, sharp. Sources apps/api/src, tests apps/api/test.
workspaces.apps/web: Vue 3, Vite 6, Pinia, vue-router, vue-tsc. Dev port 5173, proxies /api, /covers, /avatars to 127.0.0.1:3000.
workspaces.packages/shared: @frisson/shared: zod 4 schemas and sorting helpers, raw .ts exports.

structure.scripts: root: dev, build, typecheck, test, lint, format, format:check

tests.runner: Vitest 3 in apps/api and apps/web; web uses happy-dom + @vue/test-utils
tests.other_checks: npm run typecheck; npm run lint
tests.browser_tooling: None: no Playwright, Cypress or Puppeteer installed.
tests.baseline: exit 0, 316 tests, 8s on the base commit

conventions.lint_format: ESLint 9 flat config (vue essential, vue-ts recommended); Prettier: no semis, single quotes, width 100, trailing commas
conventions.git: Conventional Commits with scope, e.g. feat(web): ...
conventions.web: views/*View.vue per route; components grouped by feature; composables/useX.ts; relative imports with explicit .ts; <script setup lang="ts">; tests colocated as *.test.ts
conventions.errors: api/client.ts throws ApiRequestError; errorMessage(err) gives user-safe text; useAsyncSection for independent sections, templates branch on status with role=status/alert notes
conventions.habits: Comments explain why; '// Data classification: PUBLIC ...' at file top; user text rendered only with {{ }}; accessibility emphasised; views set document.title in onMounted ('Home · Frisson')

intent: Self-hosted manually curated music collection shown as 90s record crates; flip sleeves, pull one out, spin it. No external music APIs.
Anyone can browse; signed-in users create crates and edit their own; admins edit everything.
Shared Zod package is the API/web contract.
ADR 0006: following, Home, About, /shelf for the crate browser, demo content flagged and tagged.
Accessibility includes reduced motion and keyboard use.

relevant.summary: CrateView.vue serves both /shelf (name 'library', no id, shows store's selectedCrate, default first crate) and /crates/:id (name 'crate', public deep link, crateId prop). The 'old system' picker is the .tabs button group inside CrateView. Selection is in-memory Pinia state plus the URL. No per-crate API fetch: the store loads all crates and albums.
